name: 4'-fluoro-α-pyrrolidinooctanophenone
summary: 4'-Fluoro-α-pyrrolidinooctanophenone (also known as 4-Fluoro-PV-9, FPOP and 4-Fluoro-α-POP) is a stimulant drug of the cathinone class which has been reported as a novel designer drug.

uses.text: 4'-Fluoro-α-pyrrolidinooctanophenone (also known as 4-Fluoro-PV-9, FPOP and 4-Fluoro-α-POP) is a stimulant drug of the cathinone class which has been reported as a novel designer drug.

pharmacology.en: Little has been published about it. Related α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP block the reuptake of dopamine and noradrenaline, and it is thought to work the same way.
pharmacology.zh: 相關研究很少。α-PVP等同類的α-吡咯烷苯酮會阻斷多巴胺與正腎上腺素的回收，一般認為它也以相同方式作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 相关研究很少。α-PVP等同类的α-吡咯烷苯酮会阻断多巴胺与正肾上腺素的回收，一般认为它也以相同方式作用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the α-pyrrolidinophenones such as α-PVP, can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, overheating, insomnia, agitation, paranoia and a strong urge to keep redosing. Serious risks include psychosis, violent agitation, heart problems, seizures and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮類藥物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血壓升高、體溫過高、失眠、躁動、多疑，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。嚴重風險包括精神病、激烈躁動、心臟問題、癲癇發作與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同家族的α-吡咯烷苯酮类药物（例如α-PVP），可能引起心跳急促、血压升高、体温过高、失眠、躁动、多疑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。严重风险包括精神病、激烈躁动、心脏问题、癫痫发作与成瘾。

fact.en: Its name describes an unusually long tail: octanophenone means an eight-carbon chain attached to the benzene ring. It is the fluorinated version of PV9, one of the longest-chained members of the α-PVP family.
fact.zh: 它的名字描述了一條特別長的尾巴：「octanophenone」表示苯環上接了一條八個碳的鏈。它是PV9的氟化版本，而PV9是α-PVP家族中碳鏈最長的成員之一。
fact.zhHans: 它的名字描述了一条特别长的尾巴：「octanophenone」表示苯环上接了一条八个碳的链。它是PV9的氟化版本，而PV9是α-PVP家族中碳链最长的成员之一。
